title: Humanize: Judgement Engineering for Agentic Coding
abstract: arXiv:2610.08900v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agentic coding makes code generation cheap, but reliable completion remains difficult: the agent that writes the code is a weak judge of whether it is done.   We present Humanize, a multi-agent orchestration workflow for agentic coding built around judgement engineering: explicit, mechanically enforced decisions at the boundaries between planning, implementation, review, and learning. A human approves a plan contract, a builder agent implements it in rounds, and a reviewer agent from another vendor decides completion; deterministic hooks, not a model, route work between these roles and enforce 72 mechanical gates. Viewed as a Markov chain over repository states, alternating builder and reviewer samples jointly from two models, so a defect survives only if both miss it. We study Humanize through its deployment, 118 public postmortems of real loops, and its applications. Over 68 versions in 108 days, it gathered 1,468 GitHub stars.   A

translated_title: Humanize：面向智能体编程的判断工程
translated_abstract: 智能体编程使代码生成变得廉价，但可靠的完成仍然困难：编写代码的智能体很难判断代码是否真正完成。我们提出了Humanize，一个围绕“判断工程”构建的多智能体编排工作流：即在规划、实现、审查和学习之间的边界处进行明确的、机械强制执行的决策。由人类批准一份计划契约，构建者智能体分轮实现它，来自另一厂商的审查者智能体决定是否完成；由确定性钩子（而非模型）在这些角色之间路由工作，并强制执行72个机械关卡。将仓库状态视为马尔可夫链来看，交替的构建者与审查者从两个模型联合采样，因此缺陷只有在两者都漏检时才能存活。我们通过部署实践、118份真实循环的公开事后分析及其应用来研究Humanize。在108天内迭代68个版本，该项目获得了1,468个GitHub星标。
tldr: 提出Humanize多智能体编排工作流，通过“判断工程”让人类批准计划契约、跨厂商审查者智能体决定完成状态，并用72个机械关卡和确定性钩子强制执行角色边界，使缺陷必须同时骗过构建者与审查者两个模型才能存活。
en_tdlr: Humanize is a multi-agent orchestration workflow for agentic coding built on judgement engineering—human-approved plan contracts, cross-vendor reviewer agents deciding completion, and 72 mechanically enforced gates—so that a defect survives only if both the builder and reviewer models miss it.
